name: Debug an Error
description: Diagnose and fix a specific error in your code
template:
I'm getting this error:

```
{error_message}
```

name: Build a New Feature
description: Add new functionality to your project

name: Refactor This Code
description: Improve code structure without changing behavior
template:
Please refactor {file_path} to improve {goal}.

Specific areas to focus on:
{areas}

name: Write Tests for This File
template:
Write comprehensive tests for {file_path}.

Test framework: {framework}

Please cover:
- Happy path cases
- Edge cases
- Error handling
- Any async behavior

Put tests in the standard test directory.

name: Code Review This File
description: Get a thorough code review with improvement suggestions
template:
Please review {file_path} for:
- Code quality and readability
- Potential bugs or issues
- Performance concerns
- Security vulnerabilities
- Best practices

Provide specific line-level feedback with suggested improvements.

name: Create a PR
Explain This Code
description: Get a clear explanation of how code works
template:
Please explain what {file_path} does.

I'm specifically confused about:
{questions}

Explain it clearly, step by step, as if teaching someone new to this codebase.

name: Optimize Performance
template:
I'm experiencing performance issues in {file_path}.

Symptoms: {symptoms}

Please:
1. Profile and identify bottlenecks
2. Suggest optimizations with expected impact
3. Implement the highest-impact fixes
4. Verify the improvement

placeholders.label: What's slow? (load time, rendering, API calls, etc.)

template:

{areas}
